review_candidates.description: Primary Location Denmark-Haderslev NATO Body NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) Schedule Full-time Application Deadline 18-Nov-2026, 11:59:00 PM Salary (Pay Basis) 51,085.00 Grade NATO Grade G12 NCIA exists for one reason: to ensure the Alliance can communicate securely and reliably, whether in critical political consultations or during complex military operations. We are a key enabler of NATO's core mission to keep one billion people safe. Our technology and cyber experts power NATO's digital capabilities, from data-driven decision-making and secure networks to resilient operations and mission execution across land, air, sea, cyber and space domains. This mission is made possible by our people. We are a team of around 3,500 civilian and military staff working across 30 locations throughout Europe and North America. To meet growing operational demand, the Directorate of CIS Support Units (DCSU) is expanding its presence across a number of locations. DCSU manages, delivers and maintains communications and information systems products and services for NATO customers. Through its CIS Support Units and local CIS Support Elements, DCSU provides the vital connection between customers and NCIA's wider service-delivery organisation. CSE Haderslev, under CSU Uedem, will provide static and deployable CIS support to the 4th NATO Signal Battalion and help deliver secure, reliable end-to-end services. About The Role Provide principal-level support for the ICT platforms underpinning static and deployable CIS services in Haderslev. You will install, maintain and troubleshoot virtualised systems, software and network components, support releases and deployments, monitor performance and help end users. You will apply approved standards, maintain accurate technical records and guide work within the assigned area to ensure secure and reliable platform services. What You Will Do Configure and maintain ICT-system hardware, software and virtualisation platforms. Monitor resource use and tune system software for reliability and performance. Install and test system-software releases with fallback plans. Diagnose network and platform faults using approved methods and tools. Install or remove components and complete testing and handover. Record deployment activity and maintain configuration documentation. Support static and deployable infrastructure and platform equipment. Provide technical guidance and deputise for higher-grade staff. How You Will Contribute Everything starts with the customer and the user. You will be expected to understand customer needs, maintain direct engagement and take ownership for reliable outcomes. You will work collaboratively across organisational, professional and national boundaries, connecting customers with the right expertise and contributing to shared success across NCIA and the wider NATO Enterprise. You will act with appropriate pace and sound judgement, address obstacles and improve delivery through insight gained from customers, users and operations. What We Are Looking For We are looking for candidates who meet the technical and professional requirements of the post and who can demonstrate: A strong focus on customer and user needs Ownership, initiative and accountability Sound judgement and practical problem-solving Effective collaboration across organisational and professional boundaries The ability to work productively with autonomy Adaptability in a developing operational environment A commitment to delivering results and improving services Essential Education And Experience Higher vocational training with 3 years of post-related experience, or secondary education with 5 years of post-related experience. At least 3 years implementing and maintaining virtualisation technologies in a large organisation. Experience configuring hardware and software and troubleshooting CIS issues. Experience providing technical support to end users. VMware vSphere Foundation and/or Microsoft Server Administrator training. A thorough knowledge of one NATO language. Desirable Education And Experience Experience in distributed operations, crisis response or international military/civilian environments. Knowledge of NATO structure and enterprise infrastructure. ITIL 4 Foundation, VMware or Microsoft certification. Important Information Before Applying This post forms part of NCIA's expansion into a new or developing duty location. Practical onboarding guidance on host-nation administration may not yet be available at the time of recruitment, selection or onboarding. Candidates should be prepared to operate in a developing location environment where some practical arrangements may need to be clarified after appointment or arrival. Some local operational, administrative and support arrangements may continue to evolve. The role may therefore require a high degree of autonomy and different support arrangements from those available at an established NCIA campus. Candidates should not make assumptions about benefits, allowances, relocation support or other location-specific entitlements. Information will be provided only when formally confirmed. Any selection or appointment will remain subject to the required organisational approvals, establishment and funding arrangements, host-nation or administrative conditions, security requirements and other applicable appointment procedures. Progression through the recruitment process does not constitute a firm offer of appointment. How To Apply Please review the complete Job Description before submitting your application. Applicants must demonstrate how they meet the essential requirements and complete the prescreening questions included in the application.

review_candidates.description: 🤓 About Luminovo At Luminovo, we’re building the infrastructure that turns the electronics supply chain into something software can read and act on. Our customers use it to quote PCBAs faster, find cost savings and act on risks in their supply chain. We’re backed by Chalfen Ventures, Cherry Ventures and General Catalyst. With data centers and robotics driving demand for electronics, someone needs to manage that supply chain, and they’ll need good software to do it. (Here’s why we care so much about electronics.) 🚀 Your role Team Core is our platform team. Its job is to make all our other engineering teams more productive and to improve our codebase and infrastructure as a whole. You’ll: Keep our DevOps setup and CI/CD pipelines fast and reliable Build tools every team needs (e.g. interface for building permissions) Act as an in-house Rust expert: our backend is a Rust monolith, and Team Core helps the other teams use good Rust patterns and architecture Be responsible for the Developer Experience (DX). Help our engineers use agents more productively Other Details Location: remote-first, within two hours of CET. We prefer Munich > Berlin > Germany > Europe. Tech stack: Rust, TypeScript + React, Postgres, Clickhouse, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux 🇺🇸 Some of the work in this role falls under US export control regulations (ITAR), so you must be a US citizen. You’ll need to be based in Europe, and if you’re currently in the US, we’ll support your relocation to Germany. 🖲️ Our tech stack We always try to use the best tools available for the job. Don't worry, we don't need you to be familiar with all of these: Main monolith is written in Rust (using actix-web as our web framework), deployed on Kubernetes React and Typescript for frontend PostgreSQL for persisting our data Redis for caching and queues Flux for GitOps Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and observability garden-io for developing on Kubernetes Azure and Cloudflare for cloud computing 🤓 Whom you’ll be working with Timon, one of our Founders Alex and Tomas, two of our Staff Engineers Inga, Senior Software Engineer ⚡️ Skills, knowledge, and expertise Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here. ⚡️ About Luminovo Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry. We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain. To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million. Our core principles: putting people first & building great things As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍 Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things. We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at. review_candidates.title: Security Architect
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Security Architect Project Role Description : Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security-managed operations. Must have skills : Security Penetration Testing, MVC and Data Recovery Good to have skills : NA Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary As a Security Architect specializing in Minimum Viable Company (MVC) and Data & Cyber Recovery, the role involves defining, designing and operationalizing MVC and Data Recovery capabilities for the organization. This position helps identify the minimum set of critical business services, applications, infrastructure, data, identities and third-party dependencies required to maintain or restore essential operations following a ransomware attack, destructive cyber event or major business disruption. The role requires continuous collaboration with business continuity, crisis management, incident response, infrastructure, cloud and security teams to enable structured, secure and repeatable recovery. Roles & Responsibilities Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. Responsible for team decisions and expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams. Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions across MVC and data recovery operations. Lead the development and refinement of security policies and procedures to enhance overall cyber resilience posture. Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Lead the definition and operationalization of the Minimum Viable Company — identifying critical business services, mapping dependencies, establishing recovery tiers and developing MVC governance, decision rights and crisis-time operating models. Facilitate workshops with business, technology, security, risk, continuity and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical recovery requirements and prioritized resilience investments. Maintain alignment between MVC, business continuity, disaster recovery, incident response and crisis management. Lead current-state assessments of data protection, backup, disaster recovery and cyber recovery capabilities develop enterprise cyber recovery strategies covering critical data, applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms and identity services. Define and validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO), Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and recovery service expectations aligned with MVC priorities. Design secure backup architecture, cyber recovery vaults, clean-room environments and isolated recovery capabilities assess backup capabilities for isolation, immutability, encryption, integrity and recoverability. Establish end-to-end dependency maps for critical business services and develop sequenced recovery plans accounting for technical and business dependencies. Integrate recovery plans with cyber incident response, digital forensics, crisis management and business continuity processes support command-center activities during ransomware and destructive cyber incidents. Lead cyber recovery simulations, disaster recovery exercises and executive tabletop exercises document recovery issues, control gaps and lessons learned and track remediation through closure. Provide leadership with evidence-based reporting on recovery readiness and residual risk. Professional & Technical Skills Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Minimum Viable Company (MVC) and Data & Cyber Recovery. Strong knowledge of MVC concepts, critical business service identification and business impact and criticality assessments. Strong capability in business-service and technology dependency mapping and sequenced recovery planning aligned to RTO/RPO objectives. Experience designing or assessing enterprise cyber recovery capabilities including immutable and isolated backup principles, cyber recovery vaults and clean-room environments. Experience with secure backup architecture design, recovery blueprints and dependency-based restoration sequences across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.
